name: Smoky Chic - Inspired by Gris Dior | Sophisticated Unisex Perfume
description: Smoky Chic, inspired by the iconic Gris Dior, encapsulates sophistication and timeless beauty. This luxurious fragrance begins with the fresh citrus zest of bergamot and a subtle hint of spicy pink pepper, creating a refreshing yet intriguing opening. The heart is enriched with powdery iris, rose, and amber, enveloping you in a warm, elegant aura. The base notes of smoky vetiver, cedarwood, and musk create an opulent and long-lasting finish. Crafted with care and precision, Smoky Chic has a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, ensuring a rich, enduring fragrance that makes a lasting impression. Perfect for both day and evening wear, it offers an effortless balance of freshness and depth. Features Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper Heart Notes: Iris, Rose, Amber Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood, Musk Longevity: 8-10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for elegant affairs, evening wear, or as a signature scent Why Choose Smoky Chic? Inspired by the sophisticated Gris Dior fragrance 40-50% perfume oil concentration for a luxurious experience Suitable for both men and women, making it a versatile unisex fragrance Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume with premium natural oils Care: Store in a cool, dry place to preserve the fragrance’s full complexity Packaging: Delivered in a sleek, elegant glass bottle with a chic design
